saw_lines: Nobody buys a power bank for the spec sheet. They buy whichever one gets them through a long flight.
So the sale happens in the first line of the ad, where the offer either shows up or gets scrolled past.
Your site offers 20% off, yet 0 of your 2 ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put 20% off in line one of three new ads.
ads_1: Offer led video ads with 20% off up front, laptop charging as the proof
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter and YouTube
